<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Sandstone storm.

'''Card text:''' Use at Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, Beggar's Canyon, Lars' Moisture Farm, Jawa Camp or Mos Eisley. Target an opponent's character. Draw destiny; if destiny is greater than ability, the target is lost.

'''Lore:''' Because of its two suns, sandstorms can rage on Tatooine without warning. Strong winds can lift even stones into the air.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes sandstorms and says they can arise without warning; the English says storms strike with little or no warning.
